run_twitter_post: run the cron module to post a tweet using a Twitter account UUID and Ollama model
run_youtube_upload: run the cron module to generate a TTS video and upload it as a YouTube Short
build_twitter_post: build a script that uses the Twitter class to post content to a specified account
build_youtube_video: build a script that uses the YouTube class to generate and upload a TTS video
run_crosspost_short: run the cron module to upload a YouTube Short and cross-post it via post bridge integration
